quarterly_data.signal: Phison 1Q26 results deck (dated May 8, 2026; filed for a SinoPac investor forum on 06-12-2026): revenue NT$40,967 million, up 79.7% QoQ and 196.0% YoY, a single-quarter record; gross profit NT$25,118 million at a 61.3% gross margin (inventory write-downs reduced gross margin by approximately -1.50%); operating profit NT$14,841 million (operating margin 36.2%); net income to Phison NT$15,175 million and basic EPS NT$68.80, of which equity-method investment gains contributed approximately +NT$10.65. 1Q26 revenue contribution: AI Ecosystem Module 38%, Embedded ODM Module 25%, Industrial Module 15%, Controller 10%, Retail Module 8%, Others 4%. Inventories rose to NT$72,199 million (4Q25: NT$35,609 million; inventory turnover days 315); the company says most of its inventory is allocated to the high-value market. April 2026 revenue NT$20.207B, up 236% YoY (a single-month record); January-April revenue NT$61.174B, up 208% YoY. 2025 full-year revenue was NT$72.664 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: 1Q26 revenue NT$40,967 million (+196.0% YoY); gross margin 61.3%; EPS NT$68.80; inventories NT$72,199 million; April 2026 revenue NT$20.207B (+236% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: Phison introduces the Phison aiDAPTIV Hybrid Claw, which it calls the world's first: complex tasks are routed to cloud AI models and simple tasks are handled by local AI models on-device, with a claimed 70%+ reduction in token cost. Its aiDAPTIV Hybrid AI SSD lets a system with 32GB DRAM and CPU + iGPU run AI models of up to 120B parameters locally, keeping confidential data stored and processed on-premises. R&D expense was 21% of revenue in 1Q26 (84% of operating expenses).
quarterly_data.figure: claimed 70%+ token-cost reduction; up to 120B-parameter models locally with 32GB DRAM
